ReportItem.pluginName: SSL / TLS Weak Cipher Suites Supported
ReportItem.description: The remote service supports the use of weak SSL/TLS cipher suites that utilize 64-bit block ciphers or DES/3DES.
ReportItem.solution: Disable 64-bit ciphers and weak TLS 1.0/1.1 protocols. Enable TLS 1.2 / TLS 1.3 with AES-GCM or ChaCha20-Poly1305.
ReportItem.synopsis: Weak cryptography enabled on TLS endpoint.
